name: Auckland
intro: Auckland has the widest selection of gyms in NZ — from budget 24/7 clubs in the suburbs to premium facilities in the CBD. City Fitness and Les Mills dominate, with strong presence from Anytime Fitness, F45, Orangetheory, and ClassPass across the region.

local_gyms.description: Multiple independent powerlifting and boxing gyms alongside the main chains
Strong boutique studio scene including pilates, yoga, and CrossFit affiliates
Budget clubs and community sport centres with good access for families
A growing fitness scene with several independent clubs and Les Mills options

name: Wellington
intro: Wellington has a competitive gym market for its size. Les Mills in the CBD is popular with office workers, while City Fitness offers the best value. The compact city means most gyms are accessible by foot or a short commute, and the boutique studio scene is excellent.

local_gyms.description: High density of gyms per capita — chains and independents within walking distance of most offices
Good range of value gyms and community sport centres — often cheaper than city equivalents
Boutique studios and independent gyms catering to the eclectic local community

name: Christchurch
intro: Christchurch has strong gym coverage with competitive pricing. The flat city means cycling to the gym is easy. Les Mills has a well-equipped facility in the CBD, City Fitness offers strong budget options, and the boutique scene has grown significantly post-rebuild.

local_gyms.description: Rebuilt gym scene with modern facilities — several new boutique studios opened post-2020
High density of gyms near the university — good value options aimed at students
Newer suburb growth means several budget gyms have opened in recent years

name: Hamilton
intro: Hamilton's gym scene has grown significantly. City Fitness and Les Mills both operate here, and several boutique studios have opened in recent years. Good value for money compared to the main centres, with Contours and 9Round adding options beyond the big chains.

local_gyms.description: Main gym hub with all major chains represented plus independent powerlifting clubs
Growing northern suburbs with newer gyms and functional fitness studios

name: Tauranga
intro: Tauranga's sunny lifestyle means gym culture is strong. City Fitness has several locations across the Bay of Plenty, and the area has a growing boutique fitness scene including F45, Contours, and 9Round.

local_gyms.description: Beachside suburb with a strong fitness culture — boutique studios and PT options alongside the main chains
Newer residential area with growing gym options including CrossFit affiliates
Suburb with convenient gym access and family-friendly facilities

name: Dunedin
intro: Dunedin has a solid gym scene anchored by the University of Otago student population. Good value memberships available, with strong Les Mills and YMCA options, plus several independent gyms. One of the best student gym deals in NZ.

local_gyms.description: University area gyms with strong student rates — ask about student discounts at all clubs
Community gyms and sport centres serving the greater Dunedin area

name: Palmerston North
intro: Palmerston North (Palmy) has a solid gym scene serving both the Massey University student population and the wider Manawatū community. Good value memberships, a growing boutique scene, and all the major chains well represented.

local_gyms.description: All major chains in a compact area — easy to shop around before committing
Near Massey University — look for student rates and term-time deals
Suburban gyms with free parking — often cheaper than CBD equivalents

name: Rotorua
intro: Rotorua's gym scene is surprisingly active for its size, with the tourism economy and active outdoor culture driving demand. You'll find all the essential chains plus community sport centres offering great value. Anytime Fitness and Contours are the strongest options here.

local_gyms.description: Central gyms with easy access — look for seasonal deals tied to the tourist calendar
Suburban options with free parking and a quieter atmosphere than the city centre gyms
Community sport centres serving the local residential area

name: New Plymouth
intro: New Plymouth has an active fitness culture fuelled by the outdoor lifestyle and Taranaki's adventure-loving community. Snap Fitness and Anytime Fitness serve the 24/7 crowd, while Contours provides an excellent option for women. A tight-knit gym community with genuine value.

local_gyms.description: Compact city centre with all main gym options within easy reach
Beachside suburb with growing fitness studio options
Smaller town near New Plymouth with community gym options
